result.detail:
No formal_spec (.sby) file was submitted, because the expected outputs for this task are rtl_source and testbench. That leaves the interface spec's formal-proof requirement (section 6) and the microarchitecture's skid_buffer.sby and skid_buffer_w1.sby open for a follow-up task. The assertions under `ifdef FORMAL` are a starting point for that work.

The testbench uses only Verilog-2005 constructs plus $error. A Verilator simulation run would need --timing.

The watchdog and the normal end of the test share one verdict task, so only one verdict is printed.

The work still needs the independent review recorded by another seat.
